messages:
ava_sales: Heads-up: Acme POC blocked. After they uploaded new IdP metadata this morning, users hit 500s on login and SCIM calls returning 403. Can eng triage?

sam_se: Do we have the exact metadata they uploaded and any stack traces?

ava_sales: They provided a URL and an XML. Link they sent: https://acme.example/metadata.xml. POC logs show: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-21T09:12:01Z saml: validateAssertion: signature verification failed: invalid_certificate
POST /scim/v2/Users 403  - token_scope_error
```

leo_infra: invalid_certificate -> cert mismatch or missing intermediate. Also the 403 suggests SCIM token lacks required scopes. Can we see the <KeyDescriptor> and entityID?

maria_sso: If the customer used a metadata URL, sometimes the metadata returns rotated certs. Also verify the metadata entityID equals the issuer in incoming assertions. If those differ, our SP will reject.

jenna_poc: I grabbed the metadata snippet they uploaded: 
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://login.acme.example\">\n  <IDPSSODescriptor>\n    <KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\">\n      <KeyInfo>MIIDABCD...</KeyInfo>\n    </KeyDescriptor>\n  </IDPSSODescriptor>\n</EntityDescriptor>
```

sam_se: We currently have entityID configured as https://acme-idp.example on their tenant. That mismatch explains assertion drops. Was metadata imported automatically or via manual field?

ava_sales: It was the portal metadata import flow (they pasted metadata URL).

leo_infra: Our metadata cache TTL is 10 minutes. If they changed their IdP during that window we may have fetched older certs. I'll force-refresh their metadata cache now.

maria_sso: Also capturing the raw assertion to inspect issuer and NameID format. From the failed attempt issuer is https://login.acme.example and NameID is an email string but format unspecified. Our mapping expects emailAddress for this tenant.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: sam/saml-debug -> staging at 09:40 UTC.

sam_se: Meanwhile, ask Acme to confirm: 1) entityID in metadata matches IdP issuer, 2) SCIM token has write scopes for Users and Groups, 3) NameID format set to emailAddress.

ava_sales: Sent the checklist. They replied they changed their primary domain to login.acme.example last night and re-uploaded metadata; portal still showed old issuer.

leo_infra: Forced metadata refresh done. Rechecked assertion verification: signature now validates with new cert. SCIM still returns 403 because token scopes are scim:read only.

maria_sso: We also observed their TLS cert chain was incomplete for the SCIM endpoint; some clients tolerate but our SCIM client rejects. We can request full chain upload from them or request an exception.

sam_se: Security won't allow loosening TLS broadly. Legal can sign an exception for a temporary waiver if needed. But quicker: ask them to upload full chain; they can also regenerate token with proper scopes.

jenna_poc: Customer regenerated SCIM token with required scopes and uploaded full cert chain. Can we re-trigger provisioning?

leo_infra: Manually triggered SCIM sync at 10:45 UTC. Results: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 201 - created 3 users
POST /scim/v2/Groups 200 - updated 5 groups
```

ava_sales: Customer confirms SSO login working and group provisioning restored. POC is unblocked.

maria_sso: Action items: 1) add a warning in metadata import UI when entityID mismatch detected, 2) surface cert chain validation and token scope hints in onboarding, 3) file ENG-6421 for metadata UI improvement.

sam_se: I'll add a short playbook for sales: "If SSO breaks after metadata upload -> check entityID, cert chain completeness, NameID format, SCIM token scopes, and force metadata refresh."

ava_sales: Thanks all. Marking POC as unblocked and closing the loop with Acme. :tada:

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: sam/saml-debug -> staging at 09:40 UTC. Logs archived to /deploys/2026-03-21/saml-debug
